name: Reasoning Gym baseline derived metrics and pass@k readiness
purpose: Respond to the observation that solve_rate is often binary by adding a derived metrics dashboard over existing Reasoning Gym baseline artifacts. The dashboard reports mean official score, nonzero-score rate, truncation rate, parseability, finish_reason distribution, total tokens, and pass@k/oracle-best@k readiness. It does not add new model samples.
